purpose: Test one point-in-time surface-heating forecast family fitted on in-season B and scored once on out-of-season C without using the market benchmark as a model input.

allowed_model_inputs: target date, market identity for joining and within-market scaling, and ordered band rank
forbidden_model_inputs: settlement or any post-target observation at inference
stitched_continuous_archive or historical_forecast values without a true issue time
own_information_boundary.benchmark_use: Market probabilities may be loaded only after the candidate is frozen and only for C endpoint scoring and incumbent-frozen severity-tail membership.

point_in_time_contract.issue_time_rule: For target date T, every admitted row must have issue time T-1 at 00:00 in the market timezone.
point_in_time_contract.coverage_gate: Exactly one finite value per field, market, target date, lead day, and valid local hour is required; duplicates, gaps, a provenance mismatch, or a non-finite value fail closed before fitting.

fit_stratum_B.name: in-season B from the retained -09-56a split

test_stratum_C.name: out-of-season C from the retained -09-56a split

population.admission: Use the exact retained -09-44a/-09-56a repaired-surface row population and promotion_countable admission. Do not add staged rows after 2026-07-30 and do not substitute quality_grade == complete.

mechanism.name: lead-1 target-day surface-heating and convective-budget tilt
mechanism.hypothesis: A scalar daily-high forecast omits whether target-day heating is radiative, cloud-limited, ventilated, convective, precipitating, or evaporation-limited; those issue-time forecast states can condition a warm-versus-cool tilt of the incumbent distribution.

features.form: maximum over valid local hours 07:00-20:00, converted to Celsius-equivalent before scaling
arithmetic mean over valid local hours 07:00-20:00
arithmetic mean over valid local hours 07:00-20:00

mechanism.scaling: For every feature and market, subtract the B-only market mean and divide by the B-only market population standard deviation. Recompute these quantities inside each chronological fit and bootstrap refit. A zero standard deviation fails closed. C never influences scaling.
mechanism.market_and_cutoff_terms: No market one-hot, season term, cutoff term, interaction, feature subset, lead subset, or post-result transform may be added. Market is used only for B-only scaling and clustering.

candidate.incumbent_input: The retained repaired served probability p_s,b on every admitted snapshot-band row.
candidate.ordered_coordinate: Within each snapshot order bands cold to hot and set r_b = -1 + 2*b/(K-1), where b is zero-based and K is the number of bands.
candidate.linear_predictor: eta_s = x_market_date dot beta; x is the 12-value standardized vector above and is identical for all snapshots of one market-date.
candidate.probability_map: q_s,b = p_s,b * exp(r_b * eta_s) / sum_j[p_s,j * exp(r_j * eta_s)]. Compute with log-sum-exp arithmetic.
candidate.zero_and_floor_contract: If p_s,b is zero then q_s,b must be exactly zero. Every snapshot must retain total mass within 1e-12. The candidate may not populate a band excluded by the incumbent serving floor and may not change the floor itself.
candidate.fit_objective: On B only, minimize market-day-equal-weighted categorical negative log likelihood plus 0.5*lambda*||beta||_2^2. Each market-day has total weight one and its snapshots share that weight equally.
candidate.optimizer_contract: Use one deterministic optimizer run from the declared zero vector. Require objective convergence and gradient infinity norm <= 1e-8. No restart, alternate seed, coefficient clipping, or hyperparameter tuning is allowed.
candidate.winning_band_zero_gate: If the incumbent assigns zero probability to any realized B winning band, fail closed rather than adding epsilon mass.

B_only_screen_before_C_is_accessible.chronology: Sort the 23 B target dates. Fit on the first 10 dates, score the 11th, then expand by one date and repeat through date 23, always recomputing B-only scaling and beta.
required_checks: The full-B fitted candidate has lower total Brier than the incumbent on B.
The 13-date expanding-window candidate has lower total Brier than the incumbent on exactly the same OOF rows.
All PIT provenance, feature coverage, convergence, mass, zero-support, and floor gates pass.
B_only_screen_before_C_is_accessible.failure_action: Stop without opening C outcomes or C market probabilities. Close decision 10 unused and report the failed B-only gate; do not tune or substitute a feature family.

primary.name: total excess Brier versus market on out-of-season C
primary.brier: Mean (probability - one_hot_outcome)^2 over the exact retained C band rows.

secondary.name: incumbent-frozen severity-tail SSE on out-of-season C
secondary.membership: Before candidate endpoint scoring, freeze C band rows where incumbent squared error exceeds market squared error and abs(incumbent_probability - market_probability) >= 0.30.
secondary.improvement: Mean incumbent squared error on frozen tail rows minus mean candidate squared error on the identical rows.
secondary.gap_closure: secondary improvement divided by [incumbent tail SSE - market tail SSE] on the identical frozen rows.

required_readouts: Both endpoints, support, point improvement, gap closure, crossed standard error, two-sided alpha=0.0025 interval, 80%-power MDE, MDE as a share of the endpoint gap, and achieved power.
B and C results must remain separately labelled; no pooled B+C score is permitted.

negative_control.name: exact incumbent clone
negative_control.construction: Set q_control_s,b by direct array copy from p_incumbent_s,b on every retained row; do not refit or reserialize through the candidate map.
negative_control.provable_null: Primary improvement is identically 0 and secondary improvement is identically 0 row by row because q_control equals p_incumbent. This is an algebraic identity, not an exchangeability assumption.
negative_control.pass_rule: Both endpoint deltas must be exactly 0 before interval construction; copied probabilities and row keys must be byte-for-byte equal and mass checks must match the incumbent.
negative_control.failure_action: Return INVALID_CONTROL_FAILURE. Do not repair, replace, or reinterpret the control after C is opened; decision 10 remains spent.

inference.cluster_method: Shared-weight crossed target-date by market pigeonhole bootstrap.
inference.full_pipeline: In every draw independently resample B dates and C dates, resample the 12 shared markets once for use in both strata, recompute B-only scaling, refit beta at fixed lambda=0.01, apply the refit to C, and compute both paired endpoint improvements.
inference.interval: point improvement plus or minus z_(1-0.0025/2) times the bootstrap standard deviation; z=3.0233414397391534.
inference.mde: [z_(1-0.0025/2)+z_0.8] times the bootstrap standard deviation; multiplier K=3.8649626733120677.
inference.power_order: Write and hash support, bootstrap SE, endpoint MDE, and achieved power before emitting or interpreting the C point estimates.

P0_mde_preregistration.limitation: The feature values and candidate probabilities do not exist in this mission, so the candidate's own effect field cannot be measured. The numbers below are an explicit random-effects planning assumption, not the -09-57a repair-minus-control proxy.
P0_mde_preregistration.effect_field: For primary paired improvement aggregated to date d and market m, delta_d,m = mu + A_d + B_m + E_d,m. Let a=SD(A)/G, b=SD(B)/G, c=SD(E)/G, where G=0.021135322 is the C incumbent excess-Brier gap.
P0_mde_preregistration.floor_interpretation: The canonical approximately 3.2% 12-market floor is the unadjusted lower bound. Pricing decision 10 at alpha=0.0025 raises that lower bound to 4.414600874760865% before candidate-specific heterogeneity is added.
P0_mde_preregistration.detectability_boundary: For equal a=b=c, a 10% gap-closing effect reaches 80% power only when each component is <=0.07363718966301498. At 0.075 each, MDE is 10.185070932666174% and the declared 10% effect is not detectable.
P0_mde_preregistration.secondary_formula: Replace G and the primary A/B/E component SDs with the candidate's frozen-tail gap G_tail_C and tail-effect components; use the same D=27, M=12 formula unless actual frozen-tail support has fewer clusters, in which case use the smaller actual counts. Under equal 5%-of-tail-gap components the planning MDE is also 6.790047288444116% of the tail gap.
P0_mde_preregistration.P0_verdict: CONTINUE_CONDITIONALLY. The design can detect a plausibly material 10% gap-closing effect under the declared coherent-effect assumption, but not if equal component heterogeneity reaches approximately 7.36% of the gap.

decision_spend_and_verdict.spend_trigger: Decision 10 is spent at the first read or computation after candidate freeze that combines candidate-dependent C state with any C settlement outcome or market probability, including the negative control, candidate-native MDE, endpoint, bootstrap draw, or partial/failed attempt.
decision_spend_and_verdict.not_a_spend: Protocol publication, parser/schema/tests, PIT feature validation, C feature construction without C outcomes or market probabilities, candidate fitting on B, and the B-only screen do not spend alpha.
decision_spend_and_verdict.actual_power_gate: Before interpreting C points, reject as NO_GO_UNDERPOWERED_EFFECT_FIELD if the actual candidate-native primary MDE exceeds 10% of the C incumbent gap.
decision_spend_and_verdict.accept: All integrity and B-only gates pass; the exact-clone control passes; the actual primary MDE is <=10% of the incumbent gap; the primary improvement is positive and its two-sided alpha=0.0025 crossed lower bound is >0; and the secondary point improvement is >=0. The secondary interval is mandatory but need not exclude zero.
decision_spend_and_verdict.reject: Any other outcome is REJECT or the named fail-closed verdict. A primary win with a negative secondary point is rejected because moving loss into the severity tail is not acceptable.
decision_spend_and_verdict.confirmation: Acceptance is provisional selection, not confirmation. No post-boundary date may be pooled into this decision.

deviation_policy: Execute this protocol unchanged. Any ambiguity or implementation necessity that changes population, features, lead, aggregation, fit, gate, endpoint, control, clustering, alpha, or verdict rule invalidates decision 10; disclose it and preregister a new numbered decision before another C look.
explicitly_forbidden: provider calls during the preregistration mission
rows after 2026-07-30 in either B or C
feature, lead, aggregation, lambda, seed, endpoint, or threshold selection after any C look
weakening the observed-high serving floor or populating incumbent-zero bands
candidate promotion, activation, release-store writes, live trading, or production data writes
